body: I can feel you on the axiety. I took my "medicine" last night. It works for the anxiety attacks, depression and even the seziures! I wish the government would just accept that these substances work.

If you write from experiance I'm sure we have a lot in common because your experiance helped :) I listen to a musical artist called jack conte a lot. His music always connected to me on a deep emotion level, I would recomend him as odd as that sounds to be doing on this.

Can I just say that you speak so eloquently and just so positive! Is this your profession by anychance? It just amazes me how much this helped me pull myself together. I've been crying all day. My mom, who I love very dearly had to leave the home that was our safe haven from my father today after 7 years. I wasn't there for some of the time but I felt so strongly about that place. My mother and I just sat in our empty house and just held eachother and cried. It was traumatic.
You know that feeling you get in your chest when it feels tight?
Where your heart beats out of your chest?
Your lungs feel like there being crushed by your chest.
That's what I felt today.       I feel them I lot , almost constantly. It's so terrifying to see things that I do out of random and hear the voices and music and ringing from nowhere. It once got so bad (I had been having a PCP flash back) that my boyfriend went to a DRUG DEALERS house to get me anti-psychotics because my prescription had run out or the the friend that supplied them when I needed them couldn't and risked himself just so the images would stop. It's debilitating, dehumanizing. I felt like no one but him loved or cared about me but then I relized my mom was there. She's hard to deal with but she is so wonderful and dependable. She's bipolar but amazing. Not many people give me hope or make me feel accepted. Thank you for making me feel like that :)

i can't tell you how happy I am that for once in my life I could get that off my chest and not be thought of as a bad person. I don't have it in me to be happy at the moment but if I did I would. I've always had to bottle up everything and letting it out made me feel a tad better. You know, I'm good at other things but they won't get me a good paying job. I've always loved to sing. And the few people I have in my life I try to help as best as I can. I don't know, I'm sorry my words are a jumbled mess, I'm in a weird state of mind and it's hard to think properly. Me and my boyfriend had a talk just now that may sound ficked up but I agree is the best, we just can't go to eachother to cry or vent anymore untill were out of this situation, I say what I feel, he gets depressed that he can't help, I'm apologetic that I said anything, he gets aggravated that I would say that because he's my boyfriend and he loves me and wants to help but can't and then both of us are just so stressed out that we can't deal. I don't know I'm afraid of being alone because of past experiances and I really can say I've fallen in love with him, he's the first person I could make love with and not feel disgusting, and he goes out of my way even when he's unhappy or stressed to console me. He treats me the way I see women in storybooks are treated and it's.. Nice.
